annotation_visibility.sme1: judge verdict visible per fact AND pre-selected (anchored review)
annotation_visibility.sme2: judge verdict visible per fact, selections blank (unanchored)

chance_corrected_note: Gwet AC1 values are reported in the paper (S4.1) and are omitted from this package version. Raw agreement, n, and Wilson 95% CIs -- the quantities needed to reproduce every calibration claim -- are shipped in full here. AC1 is sensitive to the annotator merge order used to form the comparison set; the merge order will be specified alongside the values in the camera-ready version of this package.
